name: Buriti oil
description: Buriti oil (CAS 394239-67-9 ), derived from the fruit of Mauritia flexuosa, is a deep orange-colored vegetable oil prized for its high carotenoid content and oleic acid profile. Known in some markets as Fats and Glyceridic oils, it functions as a moisturizing and antioxidant-active ingredient across personal care, food, and industrial formulations. In cosmetic formulations, it is incorporated into sun care, after-sun, and skin repair products where its carotenoid load supports antioxidant activity and skin conditioning. Hair care manufacturers use it in leave-in treatments and serums targeting dry or damaged hair, where it contributes emolliency and natural color to the final product. In food applications, it serves as a functional edible oil and natural colorant in specialty nutrition products, often meeting high purity requirements for consumer safety. Coatings and sealant formulators source it as a bio-based oil component where oxidative stability and fatty acid composition influence film performance and durability. The product is supplied as a liquid oil, typically in its natural unrefined form, with refined and filtered variants available for specific cosmetic-grade applications. Standard packaging ranges from small drums to IBC containers suited to industrial volumes, with documentation commonly aligned to supplier-specific quality standards.
